sources.text: This Vendor Services Agreement (the “Agreement”) is entered into between Algeria Telecom Services S.p.A., 12 Avenue des Frères Bouadou, Algiers, Algeria (“Customer”), and Atlas Digital Solutions SARL, 25 Rue des Oliviers, Oran, Algeria (“Vendor”). The Vendor's registration number is 16B0987654 and its tax identification number is 000016098765432.

The Vendor shall provide managed IT infrastructure monitoring, technical support, incident management, preventive maintenance and monthly service reporting. The services cover the Customer's production infrastructure located in Algiers and Oran. The Vendor shall provide all personnel, tools and documentation reasonably required to perform the services.

The Agreement shall commence on 1 October 2026 and shall remain in force until 30 September 2027. The Agreement may be renewed for additional periods of twelve (12) months by mutual written agreement. Either Party must provide at least 60 days' written notice of its intention not to renew.

The annual contract value is 12,000,000 DZD excluding VAT. Prices are fixed during the initial term. Any price adjustment for a renewal period must be agreed in writing by both Parties before the renewal begins. No additional fees may be charged without the Customer's prior written approval.

The Vendor shall submit an invoice at the end of each calendar month. The Customer shall pay undisputed invoices within 30 days after receipt of a valid invoice and the corresponding monthly service report. Payments shall be made by bank transfer in Algerian dinars. The Customer may withhold amounts reasonably disputed until the dispute is resolved.

The Vendor shall provide a monthly service report no later than the fifth business day of the following month. The report shall include incidents, response and resolution times, preventive maintenance performed, outstanding actions and SLA performance. Any planned maintenance affecting production services must be notified at least 5 business days in advance.

The Vendor shall provide support 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. For a Critical incident, the Vendor must acknowledge the incident within 30 minutes and restore service within 4 hours. For a High incident, acknowledgement shall occur within 1 hour and restoration within 8 hours. For a Medium incident, acknowledgement shall occur within 4 hours and restoration within 2 business days. Failure to meet the Critical incident restoration target may result in a service credit of 2% of the monthly service fee per incident, capped at 10% of the monthly service fee.

The Vendor shall maintain qualified personnel, protect Customer systems from unauthorized access, maintain accurate service records, promptly notify the Customer of material incidents, comply with applicable laws and maintain the certifications required to perform the services. The Vendor shall not materially change the assigned technical team without prior notification to the Customer.

The Customer shall provide reasonable access to systems and facilities required for the services, designate operational contacts, provide information reasonably necessary for incident investigation and pay undisputed invoices in accordance with this Agreement.

Monthly service reports shall be deemed accepted if the Customer does not raise a written objection within 10 business days after receipt. Rejected reports must be corrected by the Vendor within 5 business days.

The Vendor warrants that the services shall be performed in a professional manner and in accordance with the requirements of this Agreement. The Vendor shall correct, at no additional cost, any material service deficiency caused by its failure to comply with the Agreement.

Each Party shall keep confidential all non-public technical, commercial, operational and security information received from the other Party. Confidentiality obligations shall remain in force during the Agreement and for five (5) years after termination. Disclosure is permitted when required by applicable law, provided that the disclosing Party gives prior notice where legally permitted.

The Vendor may process operational and contact information necessary to provide the services. The Vendor shall use such information only for the purposes of this Agreement, restrict access to authorized personnel, and notify the Customer of a confirmed personal data breach within 24 hours of becoming aware of it. At termination, the Vendor shall return or securely delete Customer data unless retention is required by law.

The Vendor shall implement access controls, strong authentication, logging, malware protection and encrypted transmission for sensitive information. Administrative access shall be limited to authorized personnel. Security incidents affecting Customer systems shall be reported without undue delay and no later than 4 hours after confirmation.

Each Party retains ownership of intellectual property owned before the Agreement. Customer-specific reports, documentation and deliverables created and paid for under this Agreement shall belong to the Customer. The Vendor retains ownership of its pre-existing tools, methodologies and know-how.

During the term, the Vendor shall maintain professional liability insurance with minimum coverage of 20,000,000 DZD and general liability insurance with minimum coverage of 10,000,000 DZD. Upon request, the Vendor shall provide evidence of valid insurance coverage.

Except for fraud, willful misconduct, breach of confidentiality, infringement of intellectual property rights, and liabilities that cannot legally be limited, each Party's aggregate liability under the Agreement shall not exceed 100% of the fees paid or payable during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

The Vendor may use subcontractors for specialized activities only with the Customer's prior written approval. The Vendor remains fully responsible for the acts and omissions of approved subcontractors. Subcontractors must comply with confidentiality and security obligations equivalent to those imposed on the Vendor.

The Customer may audit the Vendor's compliance with security, SLA and contractual obligations once per year upon at least 10 business days' prior written notice. Audits may also be conducted following a material security incident or serious contractual breach.

If the Vendor fails to deliver a contractual milestone more than 10 business days after the agreed deadline, the Customer may apply liquidated damages of 0.5% of the affected milestone value per week of delay, capped at 5% of the affected milestone value.

Neither Party shall be liable for failure caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including natural disasters, war, government restrictions and widespread telecommunications failures. The affected Party shall notify the other Party within 5 business days and take reasonable measures to mitigate the effects.

Either Party may terminate the Agreement for material breach if the breach is not cured within 30 days after written notice. The Customer may terminate the Agreement for convenience with 60 days' written notice. Either Party may terminate immediately in the event of insolvency, liquidation or cessation of business of the other Party. Upon termination, the Vendor shall provide reasonable transition assistance for up to 30 days at the rates applicable under the Agreement.

The Parties shall first attempt to resolve disputes through good-faith negotiation between their designated representatives. If unresolved within 30 days, the dispute shall be submitted to the competent courts of Algiers, Algeria. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Algeria.

Formal notices shall be made in writing and delivered by registered mail or official email to the addresses designated by each Party. Notices by email shall be deemed received on the next business day unless a delivery failure notice is received.
In case of conflict, the following order of precedence shall apply: (1) this Agreement, (2) signed amendments, (3) Statements of Work, (4) technical specifications, and (5) purchase orders.

For the Customer: Algeria Telecom Services S.p.A. — Authorized Representative: Nadia Benali, Director of Procurement. For the Vendor: Atlas Digital Solutions SARL — Authorized Representative: Karim Mansouri, Managing Director. Signature date: 15 September 2026.
